Chapter 6: I Am a Manager or Investor

episode.tagline: In these insular times of shrill nationalistic rhetoric, there is a danger that we may become less globalised instead of more. But internationalisation (aka I18N) is key to India's progress. The more Indian firms learn to compete in the global marketplace, the more our nation will prosper.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay shares his thinking around what I18N implies, how it involves more than exports, and how Indian firms can make that journey.
